name: PvpSMP
description: PVPSMP is a dual-mode server network with one shared economy and a ton of great features. Players can choose and easily switch between Lifesteal/PVP or Surivival/SMP depending on their personal play style and preferences. We're building a solid community of good people, one player at a time. Join us to battle, build, farm, grind, or just to relax.
